capabilities: cycle forward and backward through leaves in the active tab group
cycle between tab groups in the workspace root and sidebars
jump to the first or last leaf in the workspace or active tab group
focus the most recently used leaf
bind these commands to custom hotkeys
disambiguation: It navigates among leaves that are already open; it is not for searching for and opening files.
extras: README warns the plugin is currently incompatible with Outliner.MD (0.1.5), which hijacks tab focus and blocks the keyboard commands.
intentEvidence: in some cases the plugin adds convenience features not available in the native commands
motivation: The author finds searching and dropdown lists too slow and mentally effortful for files that are already open, preferring repeated keystrokes to cycle through open tabs and splits.
problem: Finding an already-open file via the Quick Switcher or search requires slow typing and scanning through a modal list, and native tab commands lack wrap-around cycling.
summary: Keyboard-command suite that cycles focus through open tabs, tab groups, and splits in the workspace.
